system.description: You gain a +10ft Move. Use this Skill Check when you would make a Dexterity Stat Check (vs. the typically lesser Stat Check Difficulty).

upgrades.description: Reduce the damage you take from foes' Surprise Attacks against you by your Rank in this skill.
Reduce all Area damage you take by 50% (rounded down).
+10ft Move. You gain a +1 Evade Buff. Roll with Advantage to Evade Attacks and effects that would apply the Held Debuff (or similar) to you.

system.limitations: This limited Skill is only available to cat-based Races, such as Cat, Cat Girl/Cat Boy, and Tigran.
